name: Tracfone
notes: Researched from public tracfone.com pages and the support.tracfone.com knowledge base (rendered with a headless browser; no sign-in, no refill submitted). Tracfone (Verizon Value) is prepaid: Unlimited Talk & Text plans are refilled every 30 days, online, in the My Account app, by text to 611611 or with a plan card. Sign-in takes a phone number, serial/SIM number or email, then Continue, then the password (loginSteps 2; engine accepts the phone only); password resets email a link. Refill Your Plan works without signing in by entering the phone number or IMEI (guestLookupFields [phone], guestLookupExact). Since 11 Feb 2026 an Auto-Refill account pays for all lines with one payment method. Auto-Refill discount: $5 a month for the first two months on the $15/$20/$25/$30 plans and an ongoing $5 on the $40 plan. Payment methods beyond credit/debit cards are not documented on the pages read, so billing.methods [card] (inferred). Declined payments put the account On Hold; customers retry with another method or call 1-800-867-7183. Not documented and set not_applicable (inferred): paper bills, payment plans, future-dated payments, cancellation (service lapses when not refilled). Plan prices are the published 30-day prices before the Auto-Refill discount. Reviewer (2026-10-10): the home page also sells the Tracfone Freedom Unlimited Data plan ($50, $45 with Auto-Refill), added to plans.

guest_pay.note: Refill without logging in: enter the phone number or IMEI of the phone that needs a plan, then choose a plan and pay.

autopay.note: Auto-Refill renews your plan automatically. All lines on an account share one Auto-Refill payment method.

scheduled_payment.note: Refills are charged when you buy them; Auto-Refill renews automatically.

paperless.note: Tracfone is prepaid and does not mail bills; a printable confirmation is shown after each online purchase.

payment_arrangement.note: Tracfone does not offer payment plans. If a payment is declined, try another payment method or call 1-800-867-7183.

cancel_service.note: There is no contract to cancel: when your plan expires without a refill, service stops. Turn off Auto-Refill to stop charges.

pay_by_mail.note: Tracfone does not take mailed payments; refill online, in the app, by text to 611611 or with a plan card from a store.

help.title: Auto-Refill
paragraphs: Auto-Refill renews your Unlimited Talk & Text plan automatically so you do not run out of service. You can enroll after adding an Unlimited Talk & Text plan.
Discounts: $5 off each month for the first two months on the $15 (1 GB), $20 (4 GB), $25 (6 GB) and $30 (10 GB) plans, and $5 off every month on the $40 (20 GB) plan.
Since February 11, 2026 Auto-Refill applies to every line on the account with one shared payment method, and accounts are limited to 10 active lines.

The Tracfone Freedom Unlimited Data plan is $50 a month, or $45 with Auto-Refill. You can also enroll a credit or debit card in Auto-Refill by texting ENROLL to 611611; all debit cards work, including government prepaid debit cards.

help.title: My payment was declined and my account is On Hold
paragraphs: If your payment method is declined and the account shows On Hold, try again with a different payment method. If it still fails, call Customer Care at 1-800-867-7183.

help.title: What happens after my plan expires?
paragraphs: Refill with another Unlimited Talk & Text plan online, by texting 611611, in the My Account app or with the Tracfone chatbot. Any previous balance is used automatically once you refill.
